name: Skills and tools
ownerWords:
Next to Harness health, add a duty that checks skills are configured correctly, in particular
- computer use (Cua)
- the search tool
and anything else agents use.
goal: Every skill and tool agents use on this Mac is installed, signed in and answers a real call: computer use (Cua), web search, the Aside browser, the MCP servers, the Prime skills, the Claude and Codex account sign-ins, the peer CLIs, the service CLIs and the repo skill reader. Tell the owner only what needs him.

metrics.label: Skill and tool checks that fail
Failed checks only the owner can fix

onMiss: Read each fail. Fix the agent ones yourself, one subagent per broken tool: config in ~/.prime/agent/settings.json, a stale skill text or link (commit auto-sns-agent skills with `node scripts/repo/agent/commit.mjs`; sieun-pi with a plain local commit), a CLI sign-in done in the owner's Aside browser, the websearch kernel copy. Re-check with `node --import tsx scripts/duties/skills-and-tools.ts --only <id>` in sieun-pi components/user-history. In your own kernel also run the read-only in-session calls: agent_observe.list_agents(), goal.get(), rlm_heartbeat.list(), compact.status(), mcp.list_connections(), aside_browser tabs, and await websearch(...) must not say "not set up". Put each owner fix (a password, a key, a macOS grant, approving a vendor install) in For you as one plain item with the exact step. off is not news. Never send anything outside.
